rejected.why: The same call: a log hall drawn on its own patch of ground, which clashed with the tileset.
Level 2, the same call as the kept one: on a patch of ground, and not the owner's pick.
Level 2, worded for nothing under it: clean, not the owner's pick.
Level 2, the same call: reads smaller than level 1.

Level 2, worded after the pick with nothing under it (larger wooden adventurers' hall with a golden thatched roof, a stone chimney, a second storey, a front door, a hanging sign and a red banner on the wall, standing alone with nothing under it, seen at a slight angle so its side wall shows, three-quarter view, no ground, no base, no grass patch, black outline, warm earthy tones, NES-era retro pixel art, few colors): lost the angle, reads head-on.
Level 2, the same call: on a grass patch again.
Level 3, the same call as the kept one: a pink roof, out of the palette.

chosenBy: The owner, 2026-10-19, in a 320×180 camp mock-up at 4× with kept hero sets (art/mockups/first-camp-4x.png). Its three-quarter angle, the front wall facing down-right, is the angle every facility follows (docs/process/assets.md, rule 16). Levels 2 and 3: the owner, 2026-10-22 (Issue-93), from a mock-up of each candidate beside level 1 and a villager on the meadow-01 ground, rolled two at a time: level 3 once, level 2 three times, the third round worded after the pick, which it did not beat. Level 2 stands on a small patch of grass, which the owner accepted; no wording removed it.
